notes.title: My pc is back from repairs! I can get back to work!
notes.content:
[p]In my last post, I said I was gonna send out my pc for repairs to change the battery.
About a month later and I have it back, not only did they change the battery but also the motherboard for some reason, I'm glad it was still in warranty because I cannot imagine the cost.[/p][p]Oddly enough, I was told that all the files on my pc would be deleted while they were fixing it but not only are thet still here, they remain pretty much untouched. I guess I spent all that time backing my stuff up for nothing. Well it's never for nothing, it's good to back your things up in case of an accident.[/p][p]Anyways, yes, I can finally get back to work on this game and it's safe to say that during this month some ideas have sprung up.[/p][p]I hope you guys are as excited as I am.[/p][p]Another thing! Aparently if a steam game gets at least 50 reviews it starts getting more visibility on steam which I'd say would be pretty great for this game. 
We are currently at 30 reviews so we're pretty close. If you haven't left a review yet I urge you to do so, even if it's just a thumbs up or a short review that just says "This game's aight I guess". And also send this game out to your friends so they too can leave a review as well.
And of course, thank you to everyone who has already left a review on this game, it helps us out so much![/p][p]Well that's all for now, back to the rpg maker mines with me I guess.[/p][p]Have a good day, guys.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Michael's Gautlet
notes.content:
Here it is, the level from yesterday completed. 

Well, the core of it is complete, there’s still the aesthetic of the level to work on, you know, destroyed walls, debris on the floor, all the good stuff that make you think of an abandoned factory. 
Also there might be some stuff I’ll have to change around but for the most part, this is the level. 

It’s name is “Michael’s Gauntlet”. Is it Michael D’Amato’s gauntlet or maybe some other Michael? Who knows. Well, I do but I won’t tell.

Here’s a video of the level

[previewyoutube=GbLkT00Ii20;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s special about this level? Well, as the gauntlet name might imply, this level is more like three smaller levels in one map. Pretty neat I think.

Word of warning for any aspiring game dev, and this is something I had to learn the hard way while making this level, DO NOT MAKE LEVELS WHERE THE LAYOUT IS BASED ON A SYMBOL. It’s not gonna make for fun level design and you’ll most certainly have to make changes to it that will end up changing the symbol a lot, to the point that it’s not even recognizable.

Sigh

Ah well, you know what they say

[i]"Live and learn, Hanging on the edge of tomorrow from the works of yesterday, If you beg or if you borrow you may never find your way"[/i]

Anything is worth trying at least once in game design but not everything is worth hanging onto

I gotta say though, the more I work on this, the more excited and hyped I get

I hope you guys are as excited for this as I am

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047189/aab0ba0401e9610c849f1b941e34a158034d0c8c.png[/img]

notes.title: Attempted to fix the bug that causes the killer to be stuck floating AGAIN!
notes.content:
What is it like the 5th or 6th time I try to fix this problem?
Just when I think it's fixed, it happens again and I have to scramble to see what caused it.
That's what happens when you use an decade old engine meant for rpg games and not horror games with bear trap mechanics.
Alas, this time it should be fixed, hopefully.
We pray.
Anyways, what was the fix this time?
Well, I made it so when a taser knife is used then the player can't instantly start placing bear traps.
This was already a really weird quirk of the game and it might have contributed for the bug, so hopefully that fixes it.

notes.title: Content from a cancelled dlc added as extra content
notes.content:
This should be the last update I release before I start working full force on the true ending update.
For this update, I decided to add three extra bosses that are accessible to the player from the ending room after they beat the default ending.
These three bosses are: 
-The Labyrinthian
-Incubus End
-BetaV1

The Labyrinthian and Incubus End are two bosses made specifically for an unannounced dlc that I ended never going through with, you know, not wanting to bury myself in projects when I still had the true ending update to work on. While very little was done for that dlc, I didn't want to wast the work I did on those bosses.
The Labyrinthian is very similar to the final chase in the default ending but it's shorter and it kinda forces the player to go out of their way to collect the blue keys.
Incubus End was to be the final boss of that dlc and it is incredibly difficult, unfairly so at times. Instead of describing it, I'll just show you this video of that boss.

[previewyoutube=hva0mjTI6ss;full][/previewyoutube]


BetaV1 was not made for any dlc, in fact it isn't even an actual boss fight. BetaV1, as the name might imply, is the map from the very first beta release of what would become Night of the Abattoir Man, so if you're interested in some NotAM History, here it is. It stays mostly true to that original release, meaning it's just as janky with some fixes to make it functional in the current build.

I would love to see what you guys think of these extra bosses. Try them out and tell me if you guys think they are fun or they're abysmal dogshit and now you're glad the dlc was cancelled.
Anyways, from now on all the work I do is for the true ending update, I'll keep you guys updated.
Much Love.
Diogo Marques

notes.title: News on the True Ending Update?
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
I'm writting this just to keep everyone up to date on the progress on the True Ending Update and this whole game in general.
As I mentioned before, I'm more focused on finishing my masters degree right now, it's almost complete. This means that the game is taking a slight back seat for now.
This, however, does not mean that I have been working on the update at all. Granted, work has been slow. For the most part, I've done some writing for some cutscenes I’m planning, drew one new character and have been coming up with ideas for maps and mechanics. 
I understand this is not much but as I said, I've been busy.
Rest assured, I have not forgotten about this game, I have so many plans that I want to put into practice and I can’t wait to be able to focus on this game once more.
Thank you to everyone who has played this game and left reviews, it really means a lot to me.
Once again I ask, if you come across any weird bug and glitches, please post them on the discussion tab or join our discord group, I want this game to be as bug free as possible.
Thank you to everyone.

notes.title: New Collectible Minigames have been added!
notes.content:
Three new minigames have been added to the game.

Donkey Driver: a racing minigame where you have to dodge donkey business men on the road

Zombie Invader: a minigame where you fight off a horde of zombies

The Star Canter: a sidescrolling spaceship minigame where you shoot down UFO's and dodge commets

These games can be found and collected during the main game and you can play them in the ending room.
Every minigame, including the previously added Trevor's Fishing, can now be played in the ending room

Speaking the ending room, after beating the neutral ending, if the player picks new game they get given the choice to go to the ending room.

notes.title: Updated the fishing minigame
notes.content: Added an on screen score counter and added the Goldfish, a fish that's worth 200 points

notes.title: Fishing minigame has been added
notes.content:
I was bored and added a fishing minigame, because that's what every horror game truly needs.
To access it, you need to beat the neutral ending and unlock the killer as a playable character.
Then in the character selection screen, select the killer and you will be given the option to play the fishing minigame.
This minigame affects nothing in the game and is just a time waster.

notes.title: Bug reports
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047189/65a45aba67ae217143f50fd480464977a24d7a0c.png[/img]

Hello everyone

Before anything thank you all for playing my game
This is the first game I ever worked on and I did it mostly by myself, with the help of some people
Because of this, undoubtedly you'll come across a bug, be it minor or even game breaking
If anyone comes across any bug, please report it immediately
The easiest way of doing this is trough steam discussions, I will check that regularly to make sure everything is fine.
However, some bug might be a little too specific and I might even need pictures to know what you're talking about, for these cases, I would urge you to join our discord. There you will find a bug report channel where you can go into more detail about the bug you encountered.

I ask all of you to be patient, I'm still learning and bumbled my way through making this game. I'm thankful for all the positive feedback so far and I want to make sure this game is as good as possible for everyone.

Thank you
